attchmntText: Dilip Buildcon Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Dilip Buildcon Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. The company reported a diversified order book of Rs. 33,081 Cr as of September 30, 2026. The Mining, Development, and Operations segment features long-term contracts with tenures of 25 to 55 years. Key projects include the Pottangi Bauxite Mine with a balance contract value of Rs. 3,837 Cr, the Pachhwara Central Coal Mine valued at Rs. 43,705 Cr, and the Siarmal Coal Mines valued at Rs. 51,077 Cr. The presentation outlines a transition to a multi-asset infrastructure model combining Execution, Asset Ownership, and Annuity Cash Flows. The company aims to increase recurring distribution income and drive capital recycling through its InvIT platform. The presentation is available on the company website at www.dilipbuildcon.com.

attchmntText: Dilip Buildcon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Dilip Buildcon Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 17% year-on-year to Rs. 2,250 crore. Profit before exceptional items and tax increased 24% to Rs. 176 crore. Profit after tax was Rs. 101 crore. Standalone revenue grew 19% to Rs. 1,686 crore. Standalone profit after tax rose 28% to Rs. 52 crore. The order book reached a record Rs. 33,081 crore as of September 30, 2026. This represents a 19% increase from Rs. 27,691 crore as of June 30, 2026. Fresh order inflow for the quarter was Rs. 7,321 crore. The company signed agreements for transmission and solar assets valued at Rs. 9,743 crore. Dilip Suryavanshi, Chairman and Managing Director, signed the filing.

attchmntText: Dilip Buildcon Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dilip Buildcon Limited approved un-audited IndAS standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 17% year-on-year to ₹2,250 crore, with profit after tax at ₹101 crore. Standalone revenue increased 19% to ₹1,686 crore, and profit after tax grew 28% to ₹52 crore. The order book reached a record ₹33,081 crore as of September 30, 2026, up 19% from June 30, 2026. Fresh order inflow for the quarter was ₹7,321 crore. The company reaffirmed its target to become net debt-free on a standalone basis by FY28. Dilip Suryavanshi, Chairman and Managing Director, signed the disclosure.

attchmntText: Dilip Buildcon Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Dilip Buildcon Limited has been declared the L-1 bidder for a project by Gurugram Metro Rail Limited. The order value is Rs. 419.47 Crores including GST. The project involves the construction of a depot and workshop for the elevated corridor of the Gurgaon Metro at Sector 33, Gurugram. The scope includes civil, architectural, and electrical and mechanical works. The completion period for the project is 21 months. The contract is an item rate agreement. The awarding entity is a domestic entity. There is no interest from the promoter group in the awarding entity. The transaction does not fall under related party transactions. The trading window for insiders is closed until 48 hours after the declaration of financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Dilip Buildcon Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Dilip Buildcon Limited has been declared the L-1 bidder for a project valued at Rs. 901.43 Crores. The order was awarded by National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited NBCC India Limited. The project involves the Development of Satellite Township Phase-1, Package-3, including Group Housing 02 and allied works. The location is Rakh Gund Aksha, Bemina, Srinagar in Jammu and Kashmir. The work is on a Design, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction EPC basis. Construction completion is required within 24 Months. This is followed by a 2-year Operation and Maintenance period. The contract is with a domestic entity. Dilip Buildcon Limited has no interest in the awarding entity. The order does not constitute a related party transaction. The trading window for insiders is closed until 48 hours after the declaration of financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
